list_images.title: List images
list_images.description: Get data about existing images. This request supports pagination using the 'page' and 'limit' parameters.

page.description: Controls the page of results to be returned. Page values start with 1.

limit.description: Controls the number of results per page. Maximum 100.

url.description: Filter for a specific image URL. Must be an exact match; no wildcards or regex (yet).

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: asset_id, url, alt_text, alt_texts, tags, metadata, created_at, errors, error_code.

create_image.title: Create image
create_image.description: Add an image and generate alt text. There are two ways to add an image: - Adding an image by URL: - The URL to your image must be publicly accessible. - Include the `url` field in your image JSON data. DO NOT include the `raw` field. - Adding an image by sending a base64-encoded binary file: - Use this method when your image is not accessible via URL (e.g. a local file). - Include the `raw` field in your image JSON data. DO NOT include the `url` field. - The `async` parameter is not supported for binary file uploads. All raw file uploads are processed synchronously. Rate Limited: Requests are limited to 4 calls per second.

image.description: The image: {url} for a publicly reachable image or {raw} for base64 data, plus optional asset_id, alt_text, tags and metadata.

async.description: Whether to add the image in the background or immediately (synchronously). When `async` is true, the API response will always be successful with an empty response body. Use webhooks to be notified when the image is added. Provider default: False.

ecomm.description: [optional] The ecommerce data to use when generating alt text specific to an ecommerce product. Providing the product and optional brand or color name will use our ecomm-specific vision system, which will include your product details in the generated alt text. Fields: product, brand, color. Required: product.

gpt_prompt.description: [optional] A Final Pass prompt to run on the initially generated alt text. Be sure to include the `{{AltText}}` macro enclosed in two curly braces -- we will substitute this macro with the initially generated alt text, then run your prompt. The result will be returned as the alt text for the image. Prompts must be written in English, even if alt text is being generated in another language.

keywords.description: [optional] Array of keywords / phrases to be considered when generating the alt text. Typically only one or two of the keywords from the array will be used in the alt text, but all may be examined when generating the result. Useful for SEO optimized alt text. Keywords must be in English, even if requesting alt text in another language

keyword_source.description: [optional] Text to use as the source of keywords for the alt text. This field will only be used if the `keywords` argument is blank. This text might be a product description, or a paragraph that describes the context of the images, etc.

lang.description: The language(s) for the generated alt text. Use comma-separated language codes (e.g., `"en,es,fr"`). Use one of our supported language codes for this parameter. You can request multiple languages by providing a comma-separated string (e.g. `"en,fr,es"`). Provider default: en.

max_chars.description: [optional] Maximum length of the generated alt text. If not specified, your account default value will be used.

model_name.description: [optional] The language model to use for alt text generation. See our documentation for details on each of these models. The model name strings correspond to the models below: `describe-detailed` = Elaborated model `describe-regular` = Standard model `describe-factual` = Matter-of-fact model `succinct-describe-factual` = Concise model `describe-terse` = Terse model (usually less than 120 characters)

negative_keywords.description: [optional] Array of negative keywords / phrases to be removed from any generated alt text. Negative keywords must be in English, even if requesting alt text in another language

overwrite.description: If `true`, any existing image with the same URL or asset ID (if provided) will be overwritten with new result data. This parameter will force a regeneration of the alt text for an existing image. Provider default: False.

timeout_secs.description: [optional] The maximum timeout, in seconds, to wait for alt text to be generated. It is strongly recommended to leave this at the default value unless you are prepared to deal with results that may not have alt text, or take longer than usual to be returned.

webhook_url.description: [optional] Alternative webhook URL for notifications for this operation. If this parameter is not set or has a value of `null`, then the default notification URL for the account will be used. When this parameter is set, webhooks will be sent here instead of the default notification URL on the account.

asset_id.description: The unique ID of the image.

url.description: The URL of the image. Will be `null` if the image was added via raw file upload.

alt_text.description: The assigned alt text of the image.

alt_texts.description: Alt text in requested languages, with language codes as keys.

tags.description: Words or phrases that you want to associate with the image.

metadata.description: Any custom information you want to store. This will be passed back on all API requests and webhooks.

created_at.description: Creation date of the image, in seconds since epoch.

errors.description: Any errors associated with this image. Note - This will be an empty object for valid images.

error_code.description: An identifier describing the type of error, if any.

search_images.title: Search images
search_images.description: Search for images in your library. This request supports pagination using the `page` and `limit` parameters. You can search by: - Alt text content: Search for words or phrases in alt text (default behavior) - Asset ID: Find a specific image by its unique identifier - URL: Search by image URL substring The search automatically detects the query type based on its format.

q.description: The search query (URL escaped). The search type is automatically detected: URL Search: If the query starts with `http://` or `https://`, it searches by URL substring. - Example: `https://cdn.example.com/products` finds all images with URLs containing that string. Asset ID Search: For other queries, the system first tries to find an exact asset ID match.

page.description: Controls the page of results to be returned. Page values start with 1.

limit.description: Controls the number of results per page. Maximum 100.

output.description: Successful image alt text results returned.

images.description: Each item is an object. Fields: asset_id, url, alt_text, alt_texts, tags, metadata, created_at, errors, error_code.

scrape_page.title: Scrape page
scrape_page.description: Crawl and scrape a web page or HTML document, generating alt text for all images on the page. Scraped images will be queued for asynchronous alt text generation in the background. The API response will contain the details of the parsed images from the HTML (but not the final generated alt text). The maximum time allowed to download a URL and parse the HTML is 3 seconds. If the source HTML page is unable to be ingested within that time, the API will return an error response. NOTE: The crawler does not execute Javascript or script tags on the source HTML page. It will only locate HTML `img` elements in the page source.

page_scrape.description: What to scrape: {url} of a public web page, or {html} with the document's HTML.

keywords.description: [optional] Array of keywords / phrases to be considered when generating the alt text for each scraped image. Typically only one or two of the keywords from the array will be used in the alt text, but all may be examined when generating the result. Useful for SEO optimized alt text. Keywords must be in English, even if requesting alt text in another language

negative_keywords.description: [optional] Array of negative keywords / phrases to be removed from any generated alt text. Negative keywords must be in English, even if requesting alt text in another language

lang.description: The language(s) for the generated alt text. Use comma-separated language codes (e.g., `"en,es,fr"`). Use one of our supported language codes for this parameter. You can request multiple languages by providing a comma-separated string (e.g. `"en,fr,es"`). Provider default: en.

include_existing.description: If `true`, scraped images that already have alt text will also be processed. Otherwise, images that already have alt text in the HTML will be skipped. Provider default: False.

output.description: Successful addition of the image URL and alt text generation.

url.description: The page URL that was scraped (can be null if you only send raw HTML).

scraped_images.description: Array of image elements scraped from the page.

total_processed.description: Number of scraped images that were queued for alt text generation. Scraped images that were not processed will have a `skip_reason` set.

errors.description: Any errors encountered during page scraping.
